name: @airprompter/agent-core
description: The pure half of the AirPrompter agent SDK: the protocol (types, trust chain, canonical JSON, arm assignment and the ramp walk), rendering, output checks, golden sets, the judge, bundle reading, telemetry row schemas, the control-plane client, and the port interfaces. No side effects at import; no sibling dependencies.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))"
